purpose: Authoritative handoff for importing real India-wide geospatial sources into the ASHA Setu map.

normalised_point_schema.id: stable source identifier or generated UUID
normalised_point_schema.name: display name
normalised_point_schema.block: block or sub-district name or LGD code

capability_tag_schema.blood_bank: verified blood centre or blood storage capability
capability_tag_schema.nrc: Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre for facility-based SAM care
capability_tag_schema.ab_hwc: Ayushman Arogya Mandir / Health and Wellness Centre
capability_tag_schema.route_network_v1: offline road graph version used for route checks
capability_tag_schema.route_ferry_crossing: known route crosses a ferry/water crossing
capability_tag_schema.route_ferry_safe: route has been verified not to require a ferry

severe_acute_malnutrition.trigger: MUAC < 115 mm or other SAM rule result

snakebite.route_constraint: avoid known ferry crossings when an offline road graph is available

sources.title: ABDM Health Facility Registry
sources.coverage: India; verified hospitals, clinics, PHCs, CHCs, sub-centres, labs, pharmacies and blood banks where registered
sources.access: official registry lookup; request authorised export/API before bulk ingestion

sources.title: National Health Resource Repository
sources.coverage: India health-resource capability and infrastructure records associated with facilities
sources.access: official registry lookup/export

sources.title: NIC HealthGIS / India Open Government Data
sources.coverage: India public health infrastructure datasets where published by NIC or a ministry
sources.access: open-data catalog download/API; select and version the exact dataset before import

sources.title: HMIS standard reports
sources.coverage: India facility identifiers and service indicators for reconciliation, not a primary point source
sources.access: official portal/report export

sources.title: OpenStreetMap health POIs via Overpass
sources.coverage: India OSM objects tagged hospital, clinic, doctors, pharmacy, laboratory and health centre
sources.access: Overpass query by state/district bbox; respect rate limits and ODbL attribution

sources.title: OpenStreetMap community POIs via Overpass
sources.coverage: India police, panchayat, community centres, ration shops, schools, roads and public services
sources.access: Overpass query by state/district bbox; ODbL attribution required

sources.title: DataMeet India GIS
sources.coverage: India administrative and thematic open GIS datasets
sources.access: Git repository download; pin commit/hash in each import manifest

sources.title: State WCD / ICDS Anganwadi directories
sources.coverage: State-specific Anganwadi centre locations; no single national public file
sources.access: state-by-state official export or API; record state portal and retrieval date

sources.title: PMBJP Jan Aushadhi Kendras
sources.coverage: India Jan Aushadhi store locator records
sources.access: official locator/export; do not scrape the interactive site without permission

sources.title: e-RaktKosh blood banks
sources.coverage: India blood-centre directory and availability search
sources.access: official directory/search; availability is time-sensitive and must retain last-updated time

sources.title: National Health Mission Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres
sources.coverage: State and district NRC records for facility-based management of children with severe acute malnutrition
sources.access: official NHM/state facility directory; import facility coordinates and verify operating status
sources.offline_strategy: join to FacilityDirectory; cache last_verified and never infer NRC capability from hospital level alone

sources.title: RBSK District Early Intervention Centres
sources.coverage: District-level DEIC referral centres for defects, deficiencies, diseases and developmental delays
sources.access: official NHM/state RBSK list; retain district hospital linkage and service disciplines
sources.offline_strategy: cache as a separate child-referral layer and link to the parent district hospital

sources.title: NHM National Ambulance Service / Patient Transport
sources.coverage: State-operated 108 emergency and 102 maternal/child patient transport services
sources.access: offline dial actions; state control-room/base locations only where an official export is provided
sources.offline_strategy: always cache dial numbers; cache base points only with timestamp and state ownership

sources.title: Emergency Response Support System 112
sources.coverage: Pan-India emergency response number and state emergency response control rooms
sources.access: one-tap offline call; live dispatch/location requires network and device permission
sources.offline_strategy: cache the 112 dial action and never present stale dispatch status as live

sources.title: NOTTO / State Eye Bank Directory
sources.coverage: National and state eye-bank/organ-and-tissue referral directory where published
sources.access: official directory or authorised state export; availability and eligibility are time-sensitive
sources.offline_strategy: cache directory contact and last verification; do not claim organ/tissue availability offline

sources.title: National Health Authority PM-JAY Empanelled Hospitals
sources.coverage: Hospitals empanelled under AB PM-JAY and applicable convergence schemes
sources.access: official NHA empanelment list/export; package and speciality data must retain effective dates
sources.offline_strategy: join PM-JAY status and packages onto FacilityDirectory; display stale-date warning before promising free care

sources.title: Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Day site plans
sources.coverage: Monthly VHSND session sites published through state/block NHM plans
sources.access: state/block plan import; no single national point file
sources.offline_strategy: cache dated sessions in the due-list and map; expire sites after the published session window

sources.title: Local Government Directory
sources.coverage: India states, districts, sub-districts, development blocks, villages, local bodies and wards
sources.access: official directory download; use LGD codes as administrative join keys

sources.title: ISRO / NRSC Bhuvan
sources.coverage: India thematic layers, settlement/POI and administrative/terrain services
sources.access: Bhuvan GIS/WMS or authorised layer download; retain service attribution

sources.title: Survey of India
sources.coverage: National reference mapping and administrative/cartographic products
sources.access: licensed/reference source; obtain permission before storing or redistributing geometry

sources.title: Geofabrik India OpenStreetMap extract
sources.coverage: Whole India OSM PBF for offline/base-map and POI extraction
sources.access: download server; import with osmium/osm2pgsql/tilemaker; OSM attribution required

sources.title: BBBike extract service
sources.coverage: Custom India district/city extracts
sources.access: user-created extract; pin extract URL and retrieval date

sources.title: OpenMapTiles schema and styles
sources.coverage: Map style/schema, not a health POI source
sources.access: style/schema import; check license for selected tiles/style

sources.title: Census 2011 PCA and village data
sources.coverage: India population and village denominators
sources.access: official dataset download; join by LGD/census codes

sources.title: NFHS-5 district indicators
sources.coverage: India district-level health and population priors; not a point dataset
sources.access: official report/dataset download; join by state/district

sources.title: Bhuvan CartoDEM
sources.coverage: India elevation/environment raster context
sources.access: GIS/raster service or authorised download

sources.title: IMD rainfall data
sources.coverage: India rainfall observations/grids for seasonal disease context
sources.access: official open-data dataset/API; retain observation timestamp and units
